title: Group features of a decomposition — group_components
text: motivating use case dummy-encoded categorical features xgboost: decomposition one-hot encoded factor spreads effect across dummies interactions (e.g. fa:fb), artifacts encoding rather meaningful interactions. Grouping dummies restores factor one feature, e.g. groups = list(f = c("fa", "fb", "fc")) turns fa, fb, fc, fa:fb, ... f, fa:x1, fa:fb:x1, ... f:x1. grouped columns x, factor reconstructed group's columns form dummy encoding (0/1 values, one active per row), active column's name level "(base)" rows active column (treatment coding). Otherwise group's column x NA plot functions used group's main effect.
